test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

Parul is known as a rigteous and honest lady.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"rigteous"** is incorrectly spelt.

 
 
• **Meaning: **This word has no meaning in English as it is incorrectly spelt.
 
• **Hindi Meaning: **यह शब्द अंग्रेजी में गलत वर्तनी है।
 
• **Example: **None, as it is not a correct word.
 
 
 
• The correct word should be **"righteous"**.
 
 
• **Meaning: **Morally right or justifiable. (नीतिकारक)
 
• **Hindi Meaning: **नीतिकारक
 
• **Example: **He was known as a righteous man who always stood up for justice.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Known **(ज्ञात): To be aware of through observation, inquiry, or information.

 
 
• **Example:** She is known for her kindness and generosity.
 
 
 
• **Lady **(महिला ): A woman (used as a polite or old-fashioned form of reference).
 
 
• **Example: **The lady at the front desk will assist you.
 
 
 
• **Honest** (ईमानदार): Free of deceit; truthful and sincere.
 
 
• **Example:** He is an honest person who never lies.
